purpose.de: Du führst durch ein Meeting: eröffnen, zurückholen, unterbrechen, abschließen.
purpose.en: You lead a meeting: open it, bring it back on track, handle interruptions, close it.

q.de: Was willst du im Meeting gerade erreichen?
q.en: What do you want to do in the meeting right now?

label.en: Open it and set the agenda
Bring the discussion back on track

phrases.en: Let's get started

note.de: Kurz und freundlich – der übliche Start.
note.en: Short and friendly – the usual way to begin.

phrases.ex: Let's get started, we have a lot to cover in thirty minutes.

phrases.en: the purpose of today's call is

note.de: Nennt das Ziel, bevor jemand abschweift.
note.en: States the goal before anyone drifts off.

phrases.ex: The purpose of today's call is to agree on the rollout date.

phrases.en: by the end of this meeting
phrases.ex: By the end of this meeting, I'd like us to have a clear owner for each task.

phrases.en: we have three items on the agenda
phrases.de: wir haben drei Punkte auf der Agenda
phrases.ex: We have three items on the agenda, starting with the budget.

phrases.en: let's park that for now

note.de: Würdigt den Punkt, verschiebt ihn aber.
note.en: Acknowledges the point but moves it aside.

phrases.ex: Good point, but let's park that for now and come back to it on Friday.

phrases.en: to bring us back to

note.en: A gentle bridge back to the agenda.

phrases.ex: To bring us back to the timeline, where do we stand on testing?

phrases.en: I'm conscious of the time
phrases.de: ich habe die Zeit im Blick

note.de: Höflicher Hinweis, dass die Zeit knapp wird.
note.en: A polite signal that time is running short.

phrases.ex: I'm conscious of the time, so let's focus on the decision we need today.

phrases.en: can we take that offline

note.de: Für Detailfragen, die nur zwei Leute betreffen.
note.en: For details that only concern two people.

phrases.ex: Can we take that offline and set up a quick call tomorrow?

phrases.en: if I could just finish my point

note.de: Bestimmt, aber höflich – du behältst das Wort.
note.en: Firm but polite – you keep the floor.

phrases.ex: If I could just finish my point, then I'm happy to hear your view.

phrases.en: sorry to jump in

note.de: So unterbrichst du selbst, ohne unhöflich zu wirken.
note.en: How to interrupt without sounding rude.

phrases.ex: Sorry to jump in, but that number is from last year.

phrases.en: let's hear from Anna first
phrases.ex: Let's hear from Anna first, she ran the pilot.

phrases.en: to sum up
phrases.ex: To sum up, we launch in May and review the numbers in June.

phrases.en: who will take the lead on
phrases.ex: Who will take the lead on the customer survey?

phrases.en: I'll send a quick recap
phrases.ex: I'll send a quick recap with the action items this afternoon.

phrases.en: let's reconvene
phrases.ex: Let's reconvene next Tuesday once the figures are in.

situation.de: Das Meeting beginnt, alle sind da. Du willst starten.
situation.en: The meeting begins and everyone is here. You want to start.

options: We are starting now the meeting
drill.ex: Let's get started, we have a lot to cover.

situation.de: Zwei Kollegen diskutieren ein Randthema. Du willst es verschieben.
situation.en: Two colleagues discuss a side topic. You want to move it aside.

note.de: Würdigt den Punkt statt ihn abzuwerten.
note.en: Values the point instead of dismissing it.

drill.ex: Good point, but let's park that for now.

situation.de: Jemand fällt dir ins Wort, bevor du fertig bist.
situation.en: Someone cuts you off before you have finished.

options: if I could just finish my point
drill.ex: If I could just finish my point, then it's your turn.

situation.de: Die Zeit wird knapp und es fehlt noch eine Entscheidung.
situation.en: Time is running short and a decision is still missing.

note.en: A polite nod to the clock.

drill.ex: I'm conscious of the time, so let's decide on the vendor.

situation.de: Am Ende fehlt noch, wer die Umfrage verantwortet.
situation.en: At the end, nobody owns the survey yet.

options: who will take the lead on

note.de: Fragt nach Verantwortung statt nach Arbeit.
note.en: Asks for ownership, not just work.

drill.ex: Who will take the lead on the survey?

situation.de: Du willst das Ergebnis zusammenfassen.
situation.en: You want to summarize the outcome.

note.en: The usual way to introduce a summary.

drill.ex: To sum up, we launch in May.

purpose.de: Du sagst Nein, ohne die Beziehung zu belasten.
purpose.en: You say no without damaging the relationship.

q.en: Who are you saying no to?

phrases.en: what we can do instead is
phrases.de: was wir stattdessen tun können, ist
phrases.ex: What we can do instead is start with a smaller pilot in March.

phrases.en: I'm afraid that won't be possible, but
phrases.de: das wird leider nicht möglich sein, aber
phrases.ex: I'm afraid that won't be possible, but we could offer a discount on training.

phrases.en: would it work for you if
phrases.de: würde es für Sie passen, wenn

note.de: Macht aus dem Nein eine Frage.
note.en: Turns the no into a question.

phrases.ex: Would it work for you if we delivered the first module in May?

phrases.en: unfortunately, that's not something we can offer
phrases.de: leider können wir das nicht anbieten
phrases.ex: Unfortunately, that's not something we can offer at this price.

phrases.en: I want to be upfront with you
phrases.de: ich möchte offen zu Ihnen sein

note.de: Kündigt Ehrlichkeit an und schafft Vertrauen.

phrases.ex: I want to be upfront with you: the custom report is out of scope.

phrases.en: that falls outside the scope of
phrases.de: das liegt außerhalb des Umfangs von

note.de: Begründet das Nein mit dem Vertrag.
note.en: Grounds the no in the contract.

phrases.ex: That falls outside the scope of our current agreement.

phrases.en: I'd love to help, but my plate is full
phrases.de: ich würde gern helfen, aber ich bin ausgelastet
phrases.ex: I'd love to help, but my plate is full until the release.

phrases.en: if I take this on, something else will slip
phrases.de: wenn ich das übernehme, rutscht etwas anderes
phrases.ex: If I take this on, something else will slip, so which one matters more?

phrases.en: can we revisit this next week
phrases.de: können wir das nächste Woche noch mal ansehen
phrases.ex: Can we revisit this next week once the audit is done?

situation.de: Ein Kunde will eine Sonderfunktion, die ihr nicht baut. Du hast eine Alternative.
situation.en: A client wants a special feature you will not build. You have an alternative.

options: what we can do instead is
drill.ex: What we can do instead is add it to the roadmap.

situation.de: Du musst einen Rabattwunsch klar ablehnen.
situation.en: You must clearly turn down a request for a discount.

options: unfortunately, that's not something we can offer
drill.ex: Unfortunately, that's not something we can offer.

situation.de: Deine Chefin gibt dir noch ein Projekt. Du bist ausgelastet.
situation.en: Your manager gives you one more project. You are fully booked.

options: if I take this on, something else will slip

note.de: Zeigt den Zielkonflikt statt zu klagen.
note.en: Shows the trade-off instead of complaining.

drill.ex: If I take this on, something else will slip.

situation.de: Der Wunsch liegt nicht im Vertrag.
situation.en: The request is not in the contract.

options: that falls outside the scope of
That is not in our paper
drill.ex: That falls outside the scope of our agreement.

situation.de: Du willst das Nein weicher klingen lassen.
situation.en: You want your no to sound softer.

options: I'm afraid that won't be possible, but
drill.ex: I'm afraid that won't be possible, but we can talk about May.

situation.de: Ein Kollege fragt nach Hilfe, du hast gerade keine Zeit.
situation.en: A colleague asks for help and you have no time right now.

options: can we revisit this next week
drill.ex: Can we revisit this next week?

purpose.de: Du sagst Ja und sicherst dabei deine Bedingung.
purpose.en: You say yes and secure your condition at the same time.

q.en: What does your yes depend on?

phrases.en: we can commit to that, provided that
phrases.de: das können wir zusagen, vorausgesetzt dass
phrases.ex: We can commit to that, provided that we get the test data by Monday.

phrases.en: that works on one condition
phrases.ex: That works on one condition: the scope stays as it is.

phrases.en: as long as we lock in the date
phrases.ex: Fine by us, as long as we lock in the date today.

phrases.en: in return for

note.de: Macht das Geben und Nehmen sichtbar.
note.en: Makes the give and take visible.

phrases.ex: We can lower the fee in return for a two-year contract.

phrases.en: if you can move on volume, we can move on price
phrases.de: wenn Sie bei der Menge entgegenkommen, kommen wir beim Preis entgegen

note.en: The classic trade in a negotiation.

phrases.ex: If you can move on volume, we can move on price.

phrases.en: that's doable within the current budget
phrases.de: das ist im aktuellen Budget machbar

note.en: A yes with a clear limit.

phrases.ex: That's doable within the current budget if we skip the extra training.

phrases.en: we're on board, subject to

note.en: A formal yes with a reservation.

phrases.ex: We're on board, subject to final approval from legal.

phrases.en: happy to go ahead if we can agree on
phrases.de: gern, wenn wir uns einigen können auf

note.en: Positive, but with an open point.

phrases.ex: Happy to go ahead if we can agree on who handles the data migration.

phrases.en: the only thing we'd need is
phrases.de: das Einzige, was wir bräuchten, ist

note.de: Klingt leicht, sichert aber die Ressource.
note.en: Sounds easy but secures the resource.

phrases.ex: The only thing we'd need is one of your admins for two days.

situation.de: Du sagst Ja, wenn der Kunde die Testdaten rechtzeitig liefert.
situation.en: You agree if the client delivers the test data in time.

options: we can commit to that, provided that
drill.ex: We can commit to that, provided that the data arrives on Monday.

situation.de: Du gibst beim Preis nach, willst aber eine längere Laufzeit.
situation.en: You lower the price but want a longer contract.

options: For the price we want more years
drill.ex: We can lower the fee in return for a two-year term.

situation.de: Die Rechtsabteilung muss noch zustimmen.
situation.en: Legal still has to approve.

options: We are in the boat, if
drill.ex: We're on board, subject to approval from legal.

situation.de: Der Kunde will mehr Menge, du willst dafür einen besseren Preis anbieten.
situation.en: The client wants more volume; you offer a better price for it.

options: if you can move on volume, we can move on price
drill.ex: If you can move on volume, we can move on price.

situation.de: Du stimmst zu, brauchst aber einen Admin des Kunden.
situation.en: You agree but need one of the client's admins.

options: the only thing we'd need is
drill.ex: The only thing we'd need is one admin for two days.

situation.de: Ja, aber nur mit festem Termin.
situation.en: Yes, but only with a fixed date.

options: as long as we lock in the date
when the date is locked maybe
drill.ex: Fine, as long as we lock in the date today.

purpose.de: Du nimmst Einwände ernst und führst zurück zum Nutzen.
purpose.en: You take objections seriously and lead back to the value.

phrases.en: I understand the concern about cost
phrases.de: ich verstehe die Sorge wegen der Kosten
phrases.ex: I understand the concern about cost, so let's look at what you save.

phrases.en: let's look at the total cost of ownership

note.de: Lenkt vom Preis auf den Gesamtwert.
note.en: Shifts from price to total value.

phrases.ex: Let's look at the total cost of ownership over three years.

phrases.en: it pays for itself within
phrases.ex: It pays for itself within eight months through saved archive space.

phrases.en: what would need to change for this to be a priority
phrases.de: was müsste sich ändern, damit das Priorität bekommt

note.de: Findet den echten Grund hinter „nicht jetzt“.
note.en: Finds the real reason behind "not now".

phrases.ex: What would need to change for this to be a priority next quarter?

phrases.en: the cost of waiting is

note.en: Shows that doing nothing has a price.

phrases.ex: The cost of waiting is another year of manual invoice checks.

phrases.en: we could start small
phrases.ex: We could start small with one department in October.

phrases.en: that's a fair question

note.de: Nimmt die Sorge ernst, ohne defensiv zu wirken.
note.en: Takes the worry seriously without sounding defensive.

phrases.ex: That's a fair question, and here is how we handle data retention.

phrases.en: to put your mind at rest
phrases.ex: To put your mind at rest, our data centers are certified and audited.

phrases.en: happy to share references from
phrases.ex: Happy to share references from two logistics clients.

phrases.en: what matters most to you in
phrases.de: was ist Ihnen am wichtigsten bei

note.de: Holt die Kriterien, statt den Wettbewerber schlechtzumachen.
note.en: Gets the criteria instead of attacking the competitor.

phrases.ex: What matters most to you in a document platform?

phrases.en: where we really differ is
phrases.de: wo wir uns wirklich unterscheiden, ist

note.de: Ein klarer Unterschied statt zehn Behauptungen.
note.en: One clear difference instead of ten claims.

phrases.ex: Where we really differ is the German-language support team.

phrases.en: I'd rather show you than tell you
phrases.de: ich zeige es Ihnen lieber, als es zu erzählen
phrases.ex: I'd rather show you than tell you, so let's set up a demo.

situation.de: „Das ist uns zu teuer.“
situation.en: "That's too expensive for us."

options: I understand the concern about cost
drill.ex: I understand the concern about cost.

situation.de: „Nicht in diesem Jahr.“
situation.en: "Not this year."

options: what would need to change for this to be a priority
drill.ex: What would need to change for this to be a priority?

situation.de: „Eure Cloud ist uns zu riskant.“
situation.en: "Your cloud is too risky for us."

options: No risk at all, trust me
drill.ex: That's a fair question, let me explain our backup process.

situation.de: „Der Wettbewerber ist günstiger.“
situation.en: "The competitor is cheaper."

options: what matters most to you in
drill.ex: What matters most to you in a new system?

situation.de: Du willst zeigen, dass sich die Lösung rechnet.
situation.en: You want to show that the solution pays off.

options: It is cheap in the end
drill.ex: It pays for itself within eight months.

situation.de: Der Kunde zögert. Du willst die Hürde senken.
situation.en: The client hesitates. You want to lower the barrier.

note.en: A small start instead of a big decision.

drill.ex: We could start small with one team.
